group.label: Memoirs · The Making of the Goddess Documentary

lines.text: My memories of that day are still hazy.

On my way to the area where the Goddess Squad was reportedly carrying out an operation, I heard a loud explosion and lost consciousness. When I opened my eyes, I came face to face with a Rapture towering over me. It was the first time I'd ever seen one from that close.
Paralyzed by fear, I even forgot to breathe. Then, an angel with white wings came to my rescue. I didn't get a good look at her, but I knew without a doubt that she was one of the Goddesses.
Even for someone like me, who had doubted them, the members of the Goddess Squad were the Goddesses of Victory.
